definitions.explanation: Having great physical power or force.
Able to withstand difficult conditions or stress.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強|つよ}いです。
⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{強|つよ}いです。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強|つよ}いです。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{強|つよ}いです。
examples.english: This flower is resistant to cold.

examples.english: My father has a strong body, so he has never gotten sick.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{強|つよ}い⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{帽子|ぼうし}→帽子：00692_boushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶって→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The sunlight is strong, so please wear a hat.

examples.english: He can hold his liquor well.

examples.english: Our dog is resistant to the heat, so even in summer it runs around energetically.

notes:
{強|つよ}い is an i-adjective meaning "strong" in various senses: physical strength, intensity, resilience, or tolerance.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {強|つよ}く
- Noun form: {強|つよ}さ (strength)
- Verb form: {強|つよ}くなる (to become strong)

USAGE PATTERNS:
- {体|からだ}が{強|つよ}い: to have a strong body
- 〜に{強|つよ}い: resistant to ~, good at ~
- お{酒|さけ}に{強|つよ}い: can hold one's liquor
- {寒|さむ}さに{強|つよ}い: resistant to cold

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風|かぜ}が{強|つよ}い: the wind is strong
- {意志|いし}が{強|つよ}い: strong-willed
- {日差|ひざ}しが{強|つよ}い: the sunlight is intense

CONTRAST: Opposite is {弱|よわ}い (weak).
